name: Mikhail Stugrev
original_name: ミハイル・スチュグレフ
source:
"Who? I've never heard of this Stugrev guy."

A spy from the Russian mafia, going by the name "Feng Xian," having undergone many cosmetic surgeries in attempts to infiltrate the Chinese underworld and sabotage the Qingyun Society. [spoiler]His brother, Dmitri, was mistakenly killed by [url=/c7177]Kong Taoluo[/url] in an assassination attempt on his life. Mikhail seeks revenge.[/spoiler]
